rules.statement: Tell my trusted person as soon as overload starts.
rules.source: At the first sign of overload, alert my phone and notify my trusted person, right as it starts.

rules.statement: A gentle vibration helps first, not a voice or a sound.
rules.source: Haptics first: a gentle vibration, not a voice or sound.

rules.statement: Don't use a voice in my ear as the first alert.
rules.source: Haptics first: a gentle vibration, not a voice or sound.

rules.statement: When my speech switches off, Timber may speak for me from my own information, and must say it is Timber speaking.
rules.source: When speech switches off, Timber speaks on its own from my personal data, and says it is Timber speaking.
